title: ATEC to Report First Quarter 2026 Financial Results on May 5, 2026
summary: Alphatec Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: ATEC), a provider of innovative solutions dedicated to revolutionizing the approach to spine surgery, announced today that it will report first quarter 2026 financial results on May 5, 2026, after the market close. The Company will host a live webcast that day at 1:30 p.m. PT / 4:30 p.m. ET. Webcast To access the live webcast, please visit the Investor Relations section of ATEC’s corporate website. Analyst Participation To participate in the question-and-answer session, analysts must register in advance using this link . Upon registration, access details, including a unique code, will be provided via email. Replay A replay of the webcast will remain available through the Investor Relations section of ATEC’s corporate website for twelve months.
